_about: Structural ceilings for npm run forensics:budget (the resource probe against a replica of the RECONCILED product, seeded by scripts/isolated/seed-production-scale.sql to the 5 Oct production shape: 22.6k jobs, a ~90 MB heap, vacuumed and analysed). Counts, never timings. Each number is the value measured on the reconciled branch (6 Oct 2026) with about 1.4x headroom; seq-scan ceilings are exact. Raising one is a decision to be argued, not a convenience. Migrations 1030 (the dequeue asks the self-improvement ceiling only when it needs it: idle pass 2.7k to 0.5k buffers) and 1031 (the unseen counts compute each project window once: 150k statements to 54) are in this budget; the stabilisation release (1023, 1025, 1027, 1028) is judged by resource-budget.stabilisation.json, which does not include them. A `hit` ceiling counts buffers touched (hit + read). Known and accepted for now: model.model_order is O(usage history) (one jobs seq scan), team_hq.pulse still scans jobs and outputs twice (an exact-count digest), team_hq.studio is dominated by per-output harness checks inside studio_activity, and the worker idle pass is already index-only on this heap.
